slides.stem: The parabola $y = -2(x - h)^2 + k$ has its vertex at $(5, 16)$ and passes through the point $(3, 8)$. What is the value of $h - k$?

slides.intro: The vertex hands you $h$ and $k$ directly.
slides.trapWhy: $21$ answers $h + k$. Read the combination twice before bubbling.

slides.title: Vertex form is a free read
slides.body:
In $y = a(x - h)^2 + k$, the vertex is $(h, k)$ — no work required. The extra point in the stem is usually just consistency dressing.

The real test is whether you answer the exact combination asked.

slides.title: When you miss one like this, Seva tells you why.
